response.sql:
WITH district_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, c.district_id, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3, c.district_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) AS all_clients
    FROM district_client_counts
)
SELECT region,
       AVG(client_count) AS average_clients_per_district,
       AVG(1.0 * client_count / totals.all_clients) AS average_share_of_all_clients
FROM district_client_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
GROUP BY region;

assumptions.assumption: Each client row represents one client, and district.A3 identifies the region. Districts with no clients are excluded, as requested.
